description: This file implements an Azure Blob Storage Logger class with methods for logging success and failure events, managing Azure authentication tokens, and uploading logs to Azure Storage. It interacts with Azure Data Lake via SDK and REST API, and is tailored for use within the litellm project to enable logging to Azure Blob Storage.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageLogger
classes.description: A logger class specialized for sending logs to Azure Blob Storage, supporting both account key and Azure AD token authentication, with methods for log collection, batch sending, and Azure-specific upload procedures.

methods.name: __init__( self, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the logger, reads environment variables for Azure Storage credentials, and starts periodic flushing.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event by adding the payload to the internal queue.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed event by adding the payload to the internal queue.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends all queued log entries to Azure Blob Storage in batch asynchronously.

methods.name: async_upload_payload_to_azure_blob_storage( self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload )
methods.description: Uploads a single payload to Azure Blob Storage, handling both creation, append, and flush steps.

methods.name: _create_file(self, client: AsyncHTTPHandler, base_url: str)
methods.description: Creates a file resource in Azure Data Lake via HTTP API.

methods.name: _append_data( self, client: AsyncHTTPHandler, base_url: str, json_payload: str )
methods.description: Appends JSON payload data to the specified Azure file.

methods.name: _flush_data(self, client: AsyncHTTPHandler, base_url: str, position: int)
methods.description: Flushes appended data to finalize the file.

methods.name: set_valid_azure_ad_token(self)
methods.description: Ensures the Azure AD token is valid and refreshes it if expired.

methods.name: str get_azure_ad_token_from_azure_storage( self, tenant_id: Optional[str], client_id: Optional[str], client_secret: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves Azure AD token for authentication via the Entra ID utility.

methods.name: _azure_ad_token_is_expired(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the current Azure AD token is expired.

methods.name: _premium_user_check(self)
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has premium access rights.

methods.name: get_service_client(self)
methods.description: Provides a cached async Data Lake Service Client, renewing it as needed.

methods.name: upload_to_azure_data_lake_with_azure_account_key( self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload )
methods.description: Uploads payload data to Azure Data Lake using SDK, creating directories and files as needed.
